tasks.short: Patrol parking areas to deter damage and theft

steps.what: Read existing parking-area patrol instructions and current access restrictions
Patrol parking areas and observe vehicles and property for damage or theft risks
outputs: completed visible patrol and direct observations

tasks.design: Keep the existing patrol instructions accessible in {DOCS} and retain the attendant's direct presence in the parking area. Native document access does not shorten the necessary reading or physical patrol, so no new software or labour saving is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The work depends on being present, observing real conditions and deterring interference with vehicles.
tasks.enabler_now: No demonstrated software change removes the necessary direct patrol in this boundary.
tasks.still_hard: Obstructed sightlines and changing behaviour require direct attention and appropriate response.
tasks.human_edge: Notice context and provide a visible deterrent while following the site's response procedure.

ambition.what: The attendant continues the actual patrol.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: visible parking patrol is physical presence and observation; a document view does not establish an equivalent deterrent or labour saving.

assumptions: OTHER means the physical parking site and ordinary patrol equipment. Boundary is a routine patrol with no incident, payment, ticket issue or damage claim. An incident's real report and escalation are separate event-driven work, not an invented record appended to every patrol.
The site supervisor maintains the existing post instructions and restrictions; the attendant reads them in s1. No new structured capture, patrol log or sensor feed is required by this proposal.

Actual instruction lookup is split from walking. The assumed existing instruction is already directly accessible; native links do not remove its required reading. Physical observation95 remains fully retained. No camera, route optimiser or model is assumed to replace presence.
No helper is deployed, so incremental upkeep is zero. Existing software runtime earns no labour saving, and no send or formal commitment is proposed.
unknowns: Whether the site actually requires a patrol log
Whether instruction access has measurable navigation overhead
research_questions: Does the current patrol contain actual repeated lookup or record entry beyond the direct instruction reading represented here?

already_counted.description: Read actual site instructions and perform the full visible patrol

incremental.description: No new helper, interface or upkeep is introduced

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 and incremental0 give net0. The cautious case is a site with obstructed sightlines where direct coverage remains essential; instruction reading5 and physical patrol95 both stay. Actual lookup was separated and native access considered; no unused patrol report or hypothetical incident baseline supplies a saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The attendant remains responsible for direct parking-area observation and visible patrol.
role.ambitious_version: The attendant provides attentive physical coverage using clear existing site instructions.
